pr_body:

<!--

  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

The HVAC mode for zone climate entities was set to FAN or OFF, because the actual HVAC mode is set for the entire ducted AC system. However, using FAN means the Google Home app wont let you set a target temperature, so I have changed  this to instead be AUTO.

comments: Hey @D3LZ-D3LZ-D3LZ, I assume you have a MyAir system with temperature sensors in each zone right, and you can change the temperature for each zone in Home Assistant just fine? I only have a e-zone so cannot test zone based temperatures, but have absolutely no problem change my system temperature through Google Home and Google Assistant.

@Bre77 I have an ezone system with temperature sensors in 4 of my 7 zones, all works perfect in home assistant, but not in the google home app. oddly if I ask google to "set master temp to xx" it happily does it. 
It looks like this might be a limitation of the google home app. Seems it is the same for blinds, no control through the app, only voice.

> @Bre77 I have an ezone system with temperature sensors in 4 of my 7 zones, all works perfect in home assistant, but not in the google home app. oddly if I ask google to "set master temp to xx" it happily does it. 
> It looks like this might be a limitation of the google home app. Seems it is the same for blinds, no control through the app, only voice. 

Oh right, so since your running e-zone, can you even set a temperature per zone? I have a gut feeling I might know what's going on, I think the Google Home API is expecting information/methods for the zone that isn't available.

@Bre77 Yeah can set zone temps and also has "myzone" I'm pretty sure the hardware behind the ezone and myair are the same, ( I installed the myair app once on my control tablet and it still controls the a/c )
So I think this is because I am setting the HVAC mode to FAN, and you cant set a target temperature for a fan. I have raised the PR to change this to AUTO which should fix this issue.

There hasn't been any activity on this issue recently. Due to the high number of incoming GitHub notifications, we have to clean some of the old issues, as many of them have already been resolved with the latest updates.
Please make sure to update to the latest Home Assistant version and check if that solves the issue. Let us know if that works for you by adding a comment 👍
This issue has now been marked as stale and will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.
This issue is valid and is pending acceptance of the PR.

review_comments: Isn't this a breaking change? Users that call the `climate.set_hvac_mode` service with the fan only mode will need to update their automations or scripts.
